full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Hey Marco! Good to see you. How was the trip to Porto?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Porto was lovely, mostly rain though. I spent two days in bookshops and ate far too many pastries.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: That sounds like my kind of holiday. I've been stuck at work on the quarterly report.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Ouch. At least the weather here has been kind. Any plans for the weekend?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Just the market and maybe a long walk if it stays dry.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Guess what, I ran the Riverside half marathon on Sunday!

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: No way, congratulations! How did it go?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Two hours and four minutes. My knees have opinions about it today.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Well earned. I've started a pottery class on Tuesday evenings, by the way. My first bowl looks like a hat.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: A hat is a start. Bring one to the picnic in May.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Deal.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: I signed up for the pottery class properly now, a whole term. The teacher, Noor, is brilliant.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: That's great. Did you decide about the car in the end?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Not yet. The mechanic says the old one has another year in it, so I'm waiting.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Sensible. I'm thinking of repainting the flat this month, the hallway especially.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Pick a colour that hides scuffs. Trust me.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: I'm putting every spare euro aside for a flat deposit, hoping to buy next spring.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: That is a serious goal. Good on you for sticking to it.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Hallway is painted. Sage green, no scuffs so far.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Very grown up. We had a team day at work, a cooking class, which was more fun than I expected.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: What did you make?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: A ridiculous number of dumplings. Everyone took some home.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: I'd have volunteered for that. Picnic is still on for the 12th of May?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Still on. Bring the frisbee.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: That picnic was perfect. Thanks for organising the food.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Thanks for the bowl! It does look slightly like a hat, but a very nice hat.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: I'll take it. Noor says my second one is actually round.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Progress. I have booked a week in the mountains for June, finally.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Jealous. Send photos.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Morning! I've started cycling to work three days a week. My legs are complaining but the mornings are nice.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: Good for you. I'm on holiday from Friday, two weeks of doing very little.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Where are you headed?

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: My aunt's place by the lake. Books, swimming, and no quarterly reports.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Marco
full_dialogue_history.text: Perfect. Bring a hat.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: I have several now, apparently.

full_dialogue_history.speaker: Priya
full_dialogue_history.text: My laptop is on its last legs. Should I just go for the top-spec model and be done with it?
